final_name.description:
Pelicans are the best source of Exotic Bird Meat. A good spot is just east of Quaker's Cove.
As you come down the road into the cove, to the left is a beach area where they often sit.

final_name.description: There are a number of fox spawn points in a circle around the edge of Armadillo, with the bulk of them to the north of the town. [#3]
all_descriptions: A good spot with a regular spawn is just north east of Emerald Station. Follow the railway line around the S-bend in the track, and you'll normally find one a few feet from the railway, by the T-Junction and the track to the little shack. [#1]
Try the western end of Big Valley, just around the 'W' of 'WEST ELIZABETH' on the map. [#2]
There are a number of fox spawn points in a circle around the edge of Armadillo, with the bulk of them to the north of the town. [#3]

final_name.description:
Go into a posse with someone, turn on friendly fire, shoot them in the knee with a Varmint Rifle using
regular ammo until downed. Revive them, then repeat until you’re finished.
all_descriptions:

final_name.description: The Dakpta River, just down from Cumberland Falls is a good spot for these, using cheese bait to avoid most of the other fish. Try the east bank, just a little above the 'r' in 'River' on the map. [#3]
all_descriptions:
Fast travel to Blackwater and fish from the wooden slipway under construction, where it slopes down
to the water. Lake Don Julio is another decent spot. [#1]
Aurora Basin in Tall Trees is a decent place to fish for Rock Bass. Cheese bait is recommended but not essential. [#2]

The Dakpta River, just down from Cumberland Falls is a good spot for these, using cheese bait to avoid most of the other fish. Try the east bank, just a little above the 'r' in 'River' on the map. [#3]
